title: My new addictive game Quantum Drop just released!
author: 3pumps1load
selftext:
Hello all!

My new game Quantum Drop just released! Quantum drop is a relaxing puzzle game where you try to stack orbs to get a high score. The game is forgiving enough to not stress about losing all the time.

You can play it for free on your browser! -> [https://slothbytegames.itch.io/quantum-drop](https://slothbytegames.itch.io/quantum-drop)

I hope you like it as much as I do, hopefully you won't be as addicted to it as I am 😛

AI disclaimer: This game was developed with the use of different AI tools. The original development of this game was done in native Swift targeting iOS. 

Claude Code orchestrated the implementation of the game and I was also using Codex for sore more UI stuff or when tokens ran out.
